steps.action: Turn on 'Rate how hard each set felt'
Start a workout and tick a set
user_sees: A one-tap rating for the set; rating it starts the rest timer
must_not: No rating shown while the switch is on

steps.action: Back in Settings, tap 'More workouts a week' three times
Tap 'Weight step' and pick another step; tap 'Reps to aim for' and pick a range
user_sees: The rows show the new choices
must_not: Suggested weights still using the old step
A choice back to its first-time value

start: Settings → Workouts → Rest timer and sounds

steps.action: Tap 'Rest-over sound' and pick the bell
user_sees: Sheet 'Rest-over sound' with 'The sound when your rest is over. The MettleUp chime is the default.'
must_not: The chime still playing at the end of rest

steps.action: Turn 'Show "In use" screen after each set' off
user_sees: No 'In use' screen after the next set

start: Settings → Workouts with a weekly goal of 7, and later none

user_sees: The button is disabled; the goal stays 7

steps.action: Remove the goal, then tap 'Fewer workouts a week'
must_not: A goal of 0 or a negative goal

start: 'Previous values' was 'Same folder' on an old version

steps.action: Open Settings → Workouts after the update
must_not: The retired 'Same folder' choice still in use

steps.action: Turn 'AI coach notes' on, then off again
user_sees: On: coach notes in the workout; off: none
must_not: A coach note shown while off

start: A member who trains at a gym; share picture gym name left at its first-time value

steps.action: Make a share picture of a workout
user_sees: The gym's name or logo on the picture (on by default) with a way to turn it off
must_not: Body weight, photos or notes on the picture
No way to leave the gym name off
